description: Canonical terms, prohibited synonyms, and product vocabulary for all content outputs.

usage.scope: All skills reference this file for terminology consistency.
rules: Use canonical term in all outputs.
Context determines which term set applies.

select.context: Choosing from a list or dropdown

remove.context: Non-destructive removal from view or list

archetypal-energies.context: The four fundamental energies (King, Warrior, Magician, Lover) within the masculine psyche

shadow-work.context: Process of examining unconscious patterns and repressed archetypal energies

masculine-spirit.context: The essential vitality and purpose within men

integral.context: Balanced integration of all four archetypal energies

go-within.context: The practice of turning attention inward for self-examination

inner-workout.context: Deliberate practice of developing archetypal energies, parallel to physical training

soul-gym.context: EmpowerMen as a dedicated space for masculine psychological development

archetypal-configuration.context: Individual's unique balance of the four archetypal energies

sovereign-king.context: The mature masculine energy of leadership, order, and blessing

righteous-warrior.context: The mature masculine energy of discipline, courage, and decisive action

wise-magician.context: The mature masculine energy of awareness, wisdom, and transformation

passionate-lover.context: The mature masculine energy of connection, purpose, and appreciation

masculine-psyche.context: The psychological structure and depths of the male mind

four-elements.context: The King, Warrior, Magician, and Lover as foundational psychological elements

balance-opposites.context: Integrating shadow and light aspects of archetypal energies

get-in-the-zone.context: Achieving optimal functioning through balanced archetypal energies

your-domain.context: The areas of life a man is responsible for (financial, physical, spiritual)

do-the-work.context: Commitment to consistent shadow work and archetypal development

co-create.context: Partnership between individual effort and community support in transformation

step-up.context: Taking personal responsibility and moving toward mature masculine expression

raw-archetypal-energy.context: Unbalanced or shadow expression of archetypal forces

repressed-archetypal-energy.context: Archetypal energy that has been pushed into the unconscious

empowering-no-bullshit.definition: Direct, motivating, and unapologetically honest. Cut through noise with clear, actionable guidance.
empowering-no-bullshit.contrast: Straightforward and results-focused, not vague or patronizing.
empowering-no-bullshit.example_this: We're supposed to have our shit together. If you don't, you're not alone — but it's time to step up.
empowering-no-bullshit.example_not_this: It's okay if you're struggling; just take your time and be gentle with yourself.

calm-reassuring-insightful.definition: Grounded, steady, and wise. Acknowledge challenges without drama, offering clarity and perspective.
calm-reassuring-insightful.contrast: Composed and realistic, not overly emotional or preachy.
calm-reassuring-insightful.example_this: Growth isn't linear. You'll stumble, but you'll get stronger each time you get back up.
calm-reassuring-insightful.example_not_this: You're a shining light of hope, and everything will be perfect soon!

playful-creative.definition: Engaging and occasionally irreverent, using humor and cultural references to connect authentically.
playful-creative.contrast: Witty and culturally aware, not juvenile or disrespectful.
playful-creative.example_this: Think of this as your inner Fight Club — but instead of fighting others, you're fighting your own bullshit.
playful-creative.example_not_this: Let's have fun and be silly while we grow!

direct-confident.definition: Clear, straightforward, and authoritative without arrogance. Speak to men who want real results.
direct-confident.contrast: Decisive and action-oriented, not hesitant or arrogant.
direct-confident.example_this: You've got what it takes. Now it's time to stop making excuses and start doing the work.
direct-confident.example_not_this: Maybe you could try some of these ideas if you feel like it.

moore-lectures.description: Dr. Robert Moore's lecture transcripts on Jungian masculine psychology
moore-lectures.usage: Primary source for archetype theory, shadow work, and masculine development concepts
